summary.text: Steve Huebert is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 90 who returned to the seat in January 2025 after serving from 2001 to 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He faces Democrat Amy Warhurst in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Steve Huebert earned a B.S. from Wichita State University.
His professional experience includes working as an ergonomic analyst and systems engineer.
Huebert previously represented Kansas House District 90 from 2001 to 2023 and assumed office again on January 13, 2025, succeeding Carl Maughan.
